 It’s Week 10, fantasy fans! Time flies when you’re having fun (or not, like last week)! We have four teams on a bye, as the Bears, Buccaneers, Broncos and Eagles are off. That leaves managers without the services of D’Andre Swift, Bucky Irving, Jonah Coleman and Saquon Barkley. The NFL will also have its final international matchup in Europe this week, as the New England Patriots and Detroit Lions will face off at FC Bayern Munich Arena in Munich, Germany.

That leaves managers without the services of D’Andre Swift, Bucky Irving, Jonah Coleman and Saquon Barkley. The NFL will also have its final international matchup in Europe this week, as the New England Patriots and Detroit Lions will face off at FC Bayern Munich Arena in Munich, Germany.
 This week’s rankings include some risers in Breece Hall and Zach Charbonnet, and there are a few good streaming options based on the matchups—check out Start ’Em, Sit ’Em for all the details! A few runners have also seen their value fall, including fantasy dud Ashton Jeanty.
